1: // Simple Orbit Escape game
2: // Canvas with id="game" expected in HTML
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
8:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
9: 
10:   // Planet at centre
11:   const planet = { x: width / 2, y: height / 2, r: 40 };
12: 
13:   // Satellite state
14:   const sat = {
15:     x: planet.x + 120,
16:     y: planet.y,
17:     vx: 0,
18:     vy: -1.5,
19:     size: 8
20:   };
21: 
22:   // Thrust parameters
23:   const THRUST = 0.05;
24: 
25:   // Meteor pool
26:   const meteors = [];
27:   const METEOR_INTERVAL = 2000; // ms
28:   const METEOR_SPEED = 2;
29:   let lastMeteor = 0;
30: 
31:   let gameOver = false;
32: 
33:   // Input handling
34:   const keys = {};
35:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
36:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
37: 
38:   function spawnMeteor() {
39:     // Choose random edge
40:     const edge = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
41:     let x, y, vx, vy;
42:     if (edge === 0) { // top
43:       x = Math.random() * width; y = -10; vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * METEOR_SPEED; vy = METEOR_SPEED;
44:     } else if (edge === 1) { // right
45:       x = width + 10; y = Math.random() * height; vx = -METEOR_SPEED; vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * METEOR_SPEED;
46:     } else if (edge === 2) { // bottom
47:       x = Math.random() * width; y = height + 10; vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * METEOR_SPEED; vy = -METEOR_SPEED;
48:     } else { // left
49:       x = -10; y = Math.random() * height; vx = METEOR_SPEED; vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * METEOR_SPEED;
50:     }
51:     meteors.push({ x, y, vx, vy, r: 6 });
52:   }
53: 
54:   function update(dt) {
55:     if (gameOver) return;
56:     // Apply thrust based on arrow keys
57:     if (keys.ArrowUp) { sat.vy -= THRUST; }
58:     if (keys.ArrowDown) { sat.vy += THRUST; }
59:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) { sat.vx -= THRUST; }
60:     if (keys.ArrowRight) { sat.vx += THRUST; }
61: 
62:     // Update position
63:     sat.x += sat.vx * dt;
64:     sat.y += sat.vy * dt;
65: 
66:     // Meteor update
67:     for (let i = meteors.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
68:       const m = meteors[i];
69:       m.x += m.vx * dt;
70:       m.y += m.vy * dt;
71:       // Remove off-screen meteors
72:       if (m.x < -20 || m.x > width + 20 || m.y < -20 || m.y > height + 20) {
73:         meteors.splice(i, 1);
74:       }
75:     }
76: 
77:     // Collisions
78:     const distPlanet = Math.hypot(sat.x - planet.x, sat.y - planet.y);
79:     if (distPlanet < planet.r + sat.size) gameOver = true; // crash into planet
80:     if (sat.x < 0 || sat.x > width || sat.y < 0 || sat.y > height) gameOver = true; // drift off-screen
81:     for (const m of meteors) {
82:       const d = Math.hypot(sat.x - m.x, sat.y - m.y);
83:       if (d < sat.size + m.r) { gameOver = true; break; }
84:     }
85: 
86:     // Spawn meteors
87:     const now = performance.now();
88:     if (now - lastMeteor > METEOR_INTERVAL) {
89:       spawnMeteor();
90:       lastMeteor = now;
91:     }
92:   }
93: 
94:   function draw() {
95:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
96:     // Planet
97:     ctx.fillStyle = '#4a6';
98:     ctx.beginPath();
99:     ctx.arc(planet.x, planet.y, planet.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
100:     ctx.fill();
101:     // Satellite
102:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
103:     ctx.beginPath();
104:     ctx.arc(sat.x, sat.y, sat.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
105:     ctx.fill();
106:     // Meteors
107:     ctx.fillStyle = '#a33';
108:     for (const m of meteors) {
109:       ctx.beginPath();
110:       ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
111:       ctx.fill();
112:     }
113:     // Game over overlay
114:     if (gameOver) {
115:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
116:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
117:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
118:       ctx.font = '36px sans-serif';
119:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
120:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
121:     }
122:   }
123: 
124:   let last = performance.now();
125:   function loop() {
126:     const now = performance.now();
127:     const dt = (now - last) / 16; // normalize to ~60fps step
128:     last = now;
129:     update(dt);
130:     draw();
131:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
132:   }
